title: print() and std::cout not showing in ros2 launch: output='screen', emulate_tty, PYTHONUNBUFFERED and pipe buffering, measured
excerpt: Why print() and std::cout vanish or arrive late under ros2 launch: output='log' by default, then 8 KiB (Python), 128 KiB (Python 3.14 on Lyrical) and 4 KiB (C++) pipe buffers, prints lost on a crash, and the fixes timed on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
